tool_args.rationale: The prior submission failed because its predictor referenced an unfitted global. This version fits all paid rows by numerical least squares and defines a self-contained predictor. A quadratic surface in the inputs that vary in the observations is the most economical testable model; unvaried inputs are deliberately omitted rather than assigned unsupported effects.
